roleplay.text:
A Scothan is born of two different Species, their parent Species. {{Flesh of the One}} gives you the body of one, {{Blood of the Other}} the lineage of the other.

Also decide how much of your blood you let show. Many Scothans hide a trait to pass for one of their parent Species, while others wear theirs with pride. If flesh and blood could not have brought you into the world and it took magic for you to be born, you are a Garthae, and the Oracles hunt you down to kill you.
